text: what does the theme file's fg-muted token do?
It colours secondary text: timestamps, hints and captions.
ok, new topic: why does the sidebar flicker on theme change?
Two writes to the theme attribute in one frame. Batching them removes the extra paint.

action.summary: The user asked what the fg-muted token does (secondary text colour) and then why the sidebar flickers on theme change. Cause found: theme-engine and ThemeProvider each write data-theme in the same frame. Fix proposed: batch the two writes into one commit.
